requiredEnvVars.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
requiredEnvVars.description: Google Gemini API Key for Safi Copilot, RCA analysis, SIF forecasting, and voice transcription

requiredEnvVars.name: PORT
requiredEnvVars.description: HTTP Port for Express/Vite server (defaults to 3000 in dev, 8080 in prod)

optionalEnvVars.name: OSHAD_API_TOKEN
optionalEnvVars.description: Abu Dhabi OSHAD-SF API authentication token

optionalEnvVars.name: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY
optionalEnvVars.description: Custom Firebase Web API Key for external Firestore/Auth deployment
